explanation: erdosproblems.com/830 records Pomerance's [Po15] bound as A(x) ≤ x exp(−(1/2 + o(1))(log x · log log x)^{1/2}); the Lean statement instead uses (log x · log log log x)^{1/2}, and the docstring explains that this follows [Po15, Theorem 1.1] rather than the page. The log log log version is the weaker (and, per the docstring, the actually proved) bound, so the formal statement is a correct record of Pomerance's theorem; the discrepancy with the page is flagged openly. Faithful to the cited paper.
